priority: P0 single-request Decode toward 100 ms/token and 10 token/s without MTP

scope.workload: pinned Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 P19/C32/max26 hot single-request Decode
scope.mtp_policy: MTP is isolated on an experiment branch and is not an implementation path, benchmark aid, or production dependency for the current target.

source.analysis_subject: docs: reject adaptive Decode scale widths at ceiling

binary.build_check: cmake --build build/orin-release -j4 completed; a later dry run reported no compile or link work

global_traffic_lower_bound.interpretation: The target is not beyond the physical memory ceiling, but it requires sustained useful traffic near 177 GB/s while still paying computation, transactions, synchronization, and small-tensor costs. The theoretical floors are screening bounds, not achievable latency predictions.

optimistic_175_gbps_screen.interpretation: This is a payload-only sensitivity calculation, not a candidate speedup or a claim that 175 GB/s is attainable for each stage.

method.target_command: taskset -c 11 build/orin-release/qwen3x-orin generate MODEL_DIR --prompt <pinned Chinese CUDA prompt> --max-tokens 26 --prefill-chunk-size 32 --projection-backend sm87
method.claim_limit: NCU durations are causal kernel diagnostics under replay and base-clock control; they do not replace the ordinary-entry formal Decode anchor.

down_scale6.interpretation: The measured LTS bytes are already close to the exact packed-weight plus scale6 payload. No open instruction-only tweak has a credible 0.30-ms/token ceiling.

gdn_state_update.interpretation: Unlike the projection kernels, GDN is not near the DRAM ceiling. Its shared-memory round trip and dependency path are a measured optimization surface.

reduce_cross_core_movement.finding: The QKV reduction scratch is CTA-local shared memory, not a cross-CTA global buffer. Projection activation requests previously audited are almost entirely L1 hits, and current projection LTS traffic is close to mandatory weight payload. Same-request kernels are causal and serial.
reduce_cross_core_movement.decision: Do not pursue generic fusion or buffering. Admit only a topology or layout candidate that removes measured L2/DRAM transactions or improves an actual-payload gate without increasing bytes.

l2_persistence.finding: The 4-MiB L2 and 2.75-MiB persisting budget cannot retain the 17.53-GB/token weight stream. The 72-MiB GDN state exceeds the persisting budget by 26.18x.
l2_persistence.decision: Do not implement weight or full-GDN persistence. A later transactional, default-off conv-state access-policy-window probe is allowed only after the higher-priority state-update and traffic-layout screens.

ssm_state_update.candidate: Keep each thread's eight-row transient BF16 state in packed registers across prediction and delta update, preserve the existing arithmetic and rounding order, then write global state once; remove the redundant shared-memory reload without changing persistent state format.

hard_gates.stop_loss: Reject and remove the candidate immediately if any exactness/resource gate fails or the first actual-payload process misses the speed and every-round gates.

global_traffic.priority: continuous P0 audit; candidate P1 after GDN
global_traffic.finding: Gate/up, down, and LM head dominate the remaining payload opportunity, but their matched NCU traffic is already close to mandatory weights and scales. A credible candidate must change useful-byte delivery or physical layout, not merely remove a tiny instruction sequence.

lm_payload_entropy_screen.decision: Reject generic LM lossless compression: its unattainable Shannon-limit screen only barely reaches the 0.30-ms/token admission gate before metadata and decode cost.

gate_up_scale_palette_zero_code_admissio.candidate: Four-bit common-scale palette with sparse raw escapes
gate_up_scale_palette_zero_code_admissio.credibility: zero-code payload scan only; not admitted to GPU implementation
gate_up_scale_palette_zero_code_admissio.warning: The selected six-bit gate/up scale experiment saved bytes but regressed, implying unpack cost larger than this palette's estimated byte benefit unless the common path is materially cheaper.

lm_exact_progressive_pruning_zero_code_a.candidate: prediction-only exact progressive MIPS or branch-and-bound with conservative rounded row/block bounds and full-production fallback
lm_exact_progressive_pruning_zero_code_a.credibility: offline activation/bound audit only; not admitted to implementation
lm_exact_progressive_pruning_zero_code_a.requirements: Every frozen Decode final-norm activation must certify the identical argmax after counting bound sidecar, first-pass, and survivor bytes; full-statistics remains on the production path.

global_traffic.down_layout_hypothesis: Test-only wavefront/K-tile-major packed-weight plus scale6 preswizzle while preserving bytes, FMA order, and 32x512 topology.

down_layout_admission.credibility: hypothesis only; not counted toward the target
down_layout_admission.decision: Keep behind GDN and the zero-code admission checks because it removes no bytes and would require a 2.20-GiB Decode-only sidecar if promoted.

priority_order: P0: implement and actual-first screen the exact GDN packed-register transient state update
P1: if GDN passes, integrate and run full model/Graph/production B1-C1-C2-B2; otherwise remove it
P1: run zero-code all-layer gate/up palette and frozen-activation LM exact-pruning admissions; implement only if their byte gates pass
P1: if still justified, screen one bounded down wavefront/K-tile-major physical-layout hypothesis with a 1.018x stop-loss before allocating a full sidecar
P2: only then consider a default-off conv-state L2 access-policy-window experiment
later: independent Prefill/Decode executors, double/triple buffering, and MTP belong to multi-request or later-stage plans

decision.reason: It is the only audited direction with a concrete redundant data path, matched NCU evidence showing substantial non-DRAM headroom, exact semantics that can be exhaustively gated, and a credible 0.30-ms/token admission threshold. Projection kernels remain the largest absolute opportunity, but no currently open exact mechanism has equally strong causal evidence.

claim_limits: This record is an audit and prioritization result, not a performance promotion. No new speedup is claimed and the formal anchor is unchanged.

Traffic payload values are lower bounds based on exact tensor formats and selected sidecars. Transaction granularity, cache behavior, small tensors, and instruction costs make real traffic and latency larger.

NCU profiles one matched production kernel launch under kernel replay, cache-control all, and base-clock control. Its durations are diagnostic and are not directly substituted into the formal ordinary-entry benchmark.
The 175-GB/s and theoretical-peak calculations are sensitivity or physical-ceiling screens, not achievable-bandwidth promises.
The GDN 0.30-ms/token value is an admission gate for a future candidate, not an achieved result.
MTP is not used anywhere in the current target path.
